text: Built the admin management view of a round table session with applicants, topics and tables tabs, stats, settings access and a dynamic timeline. Organisers manage a round table session from one page, see attendee, topic and table occupancy stats, and return quickly to All Sessions.

summary: FBF:Add an option to add internal Notes in the sessions.
text: Added an internal Notes field to sessions and exhibitor events, included in session export and import. Organisers save back-end-only notes per session or exhibitor event and see or upload them in the 'Notes' column.

summary: Exhibitor Account. Header and footer
epic: Redesign of Exhibitor account in Admin panel
text: Built the header and footer for the redesigned admin exhibitor account: logo placeholder, navigation, sticky header, Save/Cancel footer and unsaved-changes warning. Admin exhibitor pages have a sticky navigation header, a per-tab Save/Cancel footer and a warning when leaving with unsaved edits.

summary: Exhibitor Account. Team members page
epic: Redesign of Exhibitor account in Admin panel
text: Built a new admin Team members page for exhibitor accounts: searchable, paginated table with lead capture toggles and actions, plus a Contact person form. Admins can list, search, add, edit, delete and print badges for an exhibitor's team members and toggle lead capture per member.

summary: Exhibitor Account. Settings page
epic: Redesign of Exhibitor account in Admin panel
text: Built the exhibitor account Settings page in the admin panel, with category-synchronised settings, custom overrides and reset, and renamed several category settings to positive wording. Admins see which exhibitor settings follow the category or are customised, reset them to category, and manage Download Leads, video and product search visibility.

summary: Download leads feature on Exhibitor Category level and Individual exhibitor level
text: Added 'Download Leads' on/off settings at exhibitor category level and individual exhibitor level, applying to their team members. When off for a category or exhibitor, the 'Download leads' menu item disappears for that exhibitor and its team members on web and app.

text: Delivered a second round of campaign redesign: tag-style variables, a variable settings pop-up, a sender details section and clearer stats rows. Organisers see variables as tags, edit their settings from a gear icon and return to the list with a 'Campaign successfully saved' notice.

summary: Leader Dashboard
epic: Redesign of Exhibitor account in Admin panel
text: Built a Lead Dashboard in the admin panel as a refreshed Interaction Dashboard, with tabs for interactions, sponsor pop-ups, banners, list interactions and QR scans. Organisers see per-exhibitor or per-sponsor interaction counts with event averages, detailed tooltips and totals.

summary: Renaming setting under Contact Sharing
text: Renamed the Contact Sharing setting 'Watch On-demand/Online session' to 'Watch On-demand/Online sponsored session', including the reason in leads exports. Downloaded leads show the reason 'Watched On-demand/Online sponsored session'.

summary: Implement Registration Emails Template Save Confirmation Popup
text: Extended the unsaved-changes warning and the save confirmation notification from Campaigns to the other admin email template editors. Leaving an email template page with unsaved edits triggers a warning, and saving shows a success notification, across six template areas.

summary: FBF: Add a critical field on the sessions in the back-end
text: Added a back-office-only Flag as Critical checkbox to sessions and exhibitor events, with a filter, export column and import support. Organisers can flag critical sessions, filter by them in session management and see the flag in exports and imports; nothing shows on the frontend.

summary: Round tables. Notifications
text: Added round table notifications for participants, table leaders and moderators, each linking to the session pop-up on the schedule page. Attendees are told their topic and table number once tables are set, table leaders are told of their role, and moderators are told on assignment.

summary: Part 2 - Team work
text: Added real-time team working to the Website Builder: active-user avatars, live updates, block locking, shared autosave and warned version restores. Multiple admins edit one site at once, see who is working where, cannot edit a locked block, and are notified when a version is restored.

Speed Networking. Participant Check-in (MVP)
text: Built the Speed Networking session details page with a Registration List tab showing checked-in participants, with filter, search, sort and QR code actions. Organisers see who has checked in, when, and their potential matches, and can show a participant's QR code or jump to their schedule.

summary: Autologged in mode + Reach 5 in EP Registration - VinExpo
text: Linked EP's internal visitor registration login with Reach5, checking an email on both systems and creating EP accounts from Reach5 data. Users existing in Reach5 or EP are logged in; Reach5-only users get an EP account created from their data; unknown users see a standard error.

summary: Hyperlinking custom locations
text: Added a 'Hyperlinking custom locations' toggle so exhibitor events and sessions with an Other location can carry a URL. Clicking a custom location on exhibitor event and session cards, on web and in the app, opens the specified link in a new tab.

summary: Autoapproval of Exhibitor Events
text: Added an 'Auto approved' option to exhibitor event types, alongside the existing category-level auto-approval. Events submitted or resubmitted under an auto-approved type are approved automatically; otherwise category rules or the organiser decide.

summary: Exhibitor event in the Recommendations
text: Added an 'Exhibitor Event' toggle, off by default, to Networking & Matchmaking > Recommendations. When enabled, exhibitor events appear in the Recommendations section on the frontend.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking. Event Organizer Setup
text: Added an Opt-in Speed Networking session type to the admin panel, with a General setup of location, timeline and meeting settings. Organisers create opt-in sessions with dated checkpoints, meeting length, breaks and tables; maximum meetings per user is calculated automatically.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking. Pre-Registration conditions
text: Added a Conditions step to Opt-in Speed Networking setup, using categories and registration fields flagged 'Use for Speed Networking' to select participants and exhibitors. Users matching the conditions with a free timeslot are auto-added to the pre-registered list, get a schedule card and are notified.

summary: Add the “Use for Speed Networking“ checkbox to every select-type  registration form element
text: Added a 'Use for Speed Networking' checkbox to select-type fields in visitor and exhibitor registration forms. Checked fields feed the Opt-in Speed Networking session Conditions step; checkboxes are hidden when the module is off or for city/state fields.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking. Pre-registration list
text: Built the Pre-registered List tab for Opt-in Speed Networking sessions, listing buyers, sponsored and free team members and participants with statuses. Organisers search, filter and page through session users with statuses such as Pre-registered, Added by Organizer or Canceled Attendance.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking. Meeting limits and set as a Buyer
text: Added a 'Sponsored meetings limit' (default 10) for exhibitor categories and profiles, plus a buyer flag and buyer meetings limit for participant categories, for Opt-in Speed Networking. When Speed Networking is enabled, organisers cap sponsored meetings per exhibitor and define which participant categories act as buyers, and their limits.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking.  Card in My Schedule
text: Added Opt-in Speed Networking sessions as a timeslot-blocking card in My Schedule, with a legend item and a meetings list once finalised. Participants see the session in their schedule, then their meeting list once finalised, and can cancel before the revised-lists checkpoint.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking.  Offering users matchmaking proposals
text: Added a Matches list to Opt-in Speed Networking listing all active users by role, grouped by mutual and one-sided 'relevant' marks and match %. Users mark people relevant; mutual and one-sided requests drive paid and free meeting generation; voting locks at the 'Collect revised list' checkpoint.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking. Profile pages and list of meetings in user profile
text: Added Speed Networking pages to user profiles: a session list and details with timeline, sponsored meetings limit, role, exhibitor team member controls and schedule. Participants view sessions and meetings and can cancel attendance before the checkpoint; exhibitors assign team member roles and participation.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking. Table view of generated meetings
text: Added a Tables tab to opt-in speed networking session details, listing generated meetings by table with role tags and sponsored-meeting marks. Organisers can search meetings by table number, see roles and sponsored meetings, refresh data without reload and switch to edit mode.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking.  Shedule of generated meetings
text: Built the Schedule tab for Opt-in Speed Networking sessions, showing generated meetings per user with role tags, sponsored-meeting markers, filters and search. Organisers view each participant's generated meetings, filter and search them, and jump from a table tag to that table's meetings.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking. Manual adjustment of meetings by Organizer
text: Added an Edit mode to Opt-in Speed Networking tables so organisers can drag, add, delete and auto-assign participants in generated meetings. Organisers rearrange meetings by drag and drop, with rules blocking self-meetings and double-booking; buyer–sponsor pairs become sponsored.

summary: Opt-In Speed Networking.  Dynamic timeline
text: Reworked the timeline component for Opt-in Speed Networking with day and hour ranges, meeting checkpoints and admin counters. The timeline tracks from creation to 10 minutes after session end, switching to hours an hour before meetings, with counters in admin.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking.  Notifications
text: Added Opt-in Speed Networking email templates and bell notifications for being added, removed, final schedules and post-session leads. Users get emails and bell notifications with auto-login links at each stage, and a post-session email with the leads file of people met.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking. Meeting creation logic
text: Defined the Opt-in Speed Networking meeting generation logic for paid and free meetings based on relevance marks and visibility rules. Paid meetings need mutual buyer–paid team member relevance; other meetings can come from one-sided relevance, within table and slot capacity.

summary: Opt-in Speed Networking.  Card and details page in App Schedule
text: Added opt-in speed networking sessions to personal and team schedules in the mobile app, with a details page listing the user's meetings. Added users see the session block their schedule and, once lists are ready, their meeting times, tables and partners; cancelled or removed users lose it.

summary: Round tables. App part. My Schedule listing
text: Added round table session cards, detail pages, filters and change notifications to My Schedule in the mobile apps. Visitors and moderators see round table topics, location, time, sponsors and table numbers in the app schedule, read-only.

summary: Enhancing Account Switcher Visibility and Accessibility
text: Redesigned the web account switcher as a dropdown from the top-right menu and from the name on the profile page, with scrolling past five accounts. Users can switch between their own, team member, parent or child company accounts from a dropdown on desktop and mobile web.

summary: Matchmaking Sorting on all marketplace and delegates pages
text: Added 'Recommended for you' matchmaking sorting to exhibitor, product, pavilion, delegate, speaker and buyer pages, with explanatory text. Users switch between AI-recommended and A-Z sorting on these pages; sponsor sections are unaffected.

summary: Matchmaking Sorting for custom listing
text: Made custom listing table sorting and 'Recommended for you' matchmaking sorting mutually exclusive on exhibitor, pavilion, delegate, buyer and speaker pages. Choosing a column sort in the custom listing turns off 'Recommended for you', which is hidden when matchmaking settings disallow it.

summary: Removing Matchmaking sorting on Marketplace setting
text: Removed the separate marketplace Matchmaking sorting setting; enabling Matchmaking now makes 'Recommended for you' sorting available. With Matchmaking on, users can sort by 'Recommended for you' (optionally the default); existing clients keep A-Z sorting at release.

summary: Edit Error Message Text on Print Badge direct link
text: Replaced the error on the custom badge printing page for company profiles with a 'No badges available' message pointing to Profile Info → Print Badge. Exhibitors on /profile/badge see a clear message on where to print team member badges, in the same layout as before.

summary: Email and platform notifications for events
text: Added email and platform notifications for exhibitor event submission, approval, rejection and change requests, with default templates and an enabling toggle. Organisers get emails on submissions and changes; exhibitors get emails and optional platform notifications on approvals and rejections, with the reason and a link.

summary: Klipso Integration - Team member admin
text: Mapped the contact person fields received from the Klipso integration (cp_email, cp_title, cp_name, cp_surname) to the team member admin on EP. Exhibitors synced from Klipso get their team member admin filled in automatically from the contact person data.

summary: Dynamic Event Handling for User Session Management: App
text: Made the app check on launch that the user's logged-in event is still in the backend event list. If the event no longer exists the user is logged out and shown an event selection screen, or the single available event's login.
